items.q: Is engagement rate by followers or by reach better?
items.a: Rate by reach shows how well a post performed with the people who saw it, while rate by followers is easier to compare across accounts. The tool shows both when you add reach.

items.q: Why is my engagement rate low?
items.a: Common reasons are weak hooks, posting at the wrong time, too many promotional posts and low-quality images. Test one change at a time.

items.q: Is the engagement rate calculator free?
items.a: Yes. The engagement rate calculator is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.
